description: Delete one of your own signed posts, with a signature from prepare_delete: pass room, seq, address, signedAt and signature (all required). Its text becomes "[deleted by author]" and its number stays. Says "archived": true if a copy was already archived on Walrus (that copy stays).

seq.description: Required: the number of your post.

signature.description: Required: your base64 Sui personal-message signature over messageToSign.

name: delete_post
title: Delete your post
